import re
from datetime import date

_MONTHS = {
    "jan": 1, "january": 1,
    "feb": 2, "february": 2,
    "mar": 3, "march": 3,
    "apr": 4, "april": 4,
    "may": 5,
    "jun": 6, "june": 6,
    "jul": 7, "july": 7,
    "aug": 8, "august": 8,
    "sep": 9, "sept": 9, "september": 9,
    "oct": 10, "october": 10,
    "nov": 11, "november": 11,
    "dec": 12, "december": 12,
}

_WEEKDAY_PREFIX = re.compile(
    r"^(monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday|"
    r"mon|tues|tue|wed|thurs|thur|thu|fri|sat|sun)\.?\s+",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def _to_iso(year: int, month: int, day: int):
    """Return an ISO date string, or None if the calendar date is invalid."""
    try:
        return date(year, month, day).isoformat()
    except (ValueError, OverflowError):
        return None


def _month_number(word: str):
    return _MONTHS.get(word.lower().rstrip("."))


def _normalize(s: str) -> str:
    t = s.strip()
    t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t)
    # Drop ordinal suffixes: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th ...
    t = re.sub(r"(?<=\d)(st|nd|rd|th)\b", "", t, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    # Drop commas
    t = t.replace(",", " ")
    t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t).strip()
    # Drop a leading weekday name
    t = _WEEKDAY_PREFIX.sub("", t, count=1)
    return t


def parse(s: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(s, str):
        return "INVALID"

    t = _normalize(s)
    if not t:
        return "INVALID"

    # YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY.MM.DD (separators must match)
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{4})([-/.])(\d{1,2})\2(\d{1,2})", t)
    if m:
        result = _to_iso(int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(3)), int(m.group(4)))
        return result or "INVALID"

    # Compact YYYYMMDD
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{4})(\d{2})(\d{2})", t)
    if m:
        result = _to_iso(int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3)))
        return result or "INVALID"

    # Numeric DD/MM/YYYY (day-first; separators must match)
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,2})([-/.])(\d{1,2})\2(\d{4})", t)
    if m:
        result = _to_iso(int(m.group(4)), int(m.group(3)), int(m.group(1)))
        return result or "INVALID"

    # D Month YYYY, e.g. "5 March 2024", "5-Mar-2024", "5March2024"
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,2})[\s-]*([A-Za-z]+)\.?[\s-]*(\d{4})", t)
    if m:
        month = _month_number(m.group(2))
        if month:
            result = _to_iso(int(m.group(3)), month, int(m.group(1)))
            return result or "INVALID"
        return "INVALID"

    # Month D YYYY, e.g. "March 5 2024", "Mar-05-2024"
    m = re.fullmatch(r"([A-Za-z]+)\.?[\s-]*(\d{1,2})[\s-]*(\d{4})", t)
    if m:
        month = _month_number(m.group(1))
        if month:
            result = _to_iso(int(m.group(3)), month, int(m.group(2)))
            return result or "INVALID"
        return "INVALID"

    # YYYY Month D, e.g. "2024 March 5", "2024-Mar-05"
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{4})[\s-]*([A-Za-z]+)\.?[\s-]*(\d{1,2})", t)
    if m:
        month = _month_number(m.group(2))
        if month:
            result = _to_iso(int(m.group(1)), month, int(m.group(3)))
            return result or "INVALID"
        return "INVALID"

    return "INVALID"

import re
from datetime import date

_MONTHS = {
    "jan": 1, "january": 1,
    "feb": 2, "february": 2,
    "mar": 3, "march": 3,
    "apr": 4, "april": 4,
    "may": 5,
    "jun": 6, "june": 6,
    "jul": 7, "july": 7,
    "aug": 8, "august": 8,
    "sep": 9, "sept": 9, "september": 9,
    "oct": 10, "october": 10,
    "nov": 11, "november": 11,
    "dec": 12, "december": 12,
}

_WEEKDAY_PREFIX = re.compile(
    r"^(?:monday|mon|tuesday|tues|tue|wednesday|wed|"
    r"thursday|thurs|thur|thu|friday|fri|saturday|sat|sunday|sun)\b\s*"
)
_PERIOD_AFTER_LETTER = re.compile(r"(?<=[a-z])\.")
_OF_WORD = re.compile(r"\bof\b")
_ORDINAL = re.compile(r"(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)\b")
_YMD = re.compile(r"(\d{4})\s*[-/.]\s*(\d{1,2})\s*[-/.]\s*(\d{1,2})")
# Numeric dates are day-first: "05/03/2024" -> 2024-03-05, "31/12/1999" -> 1999-12-31.
_DMY_NUM = re.compile(r"(\d{1,2})\s*[-/.]\s*(\d{1,2})\s*[-/.]\s*(\d{4})")
_DMY_TEXT = re.compile(r"(\d{1,2})\s+([a-z]+)\s+(\d{4})")
_MDY_TEXT = re.compile(r"([a-z]+)\s+(\d{1,2})\s+(\d{4})")
_SPACES = re.compile(r"\s+")


def _build(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> str:
    try:
        d = date(year, month, day)  # validates month range, day range, and leap years
    except ValueError:
        return "INVALID"
    return d.isoformat()


def _normalize(s: str) -> str:
    text = s.strip().lower()
    text = _PERIOD_AFTER_LETTER.sub("", text)      # "mar." -> "mar"
    text = text.replace(",", " ")
    text = _SPACES.sub(" ", text).strip()
    text = _ORDINAL.sub(r"\1", text)               # "5th" -> "5"
    text = _WEEKDAY_PREFIX.sub("", text, count=1)  # drop leading weekday
    text = _OF_WORD.sub(" ", text)                 # "5 of march" -> "5 march"
    text = _SPACES.sub(" ", text).strip()
    return text


def parse(s: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(s, str):
        return "INVALID"

    text = _normalize(s)
    if not text:
        return "INVALID"

    m = _YMD.fullmatch(text)
    if m:
        year, month, day = (int(g) for g in m.groups())
        return _build(year, month, day)

    m = _DMY_NUM.fullmatch(text)
    if m:
        day, month, year = (int(g) for g in m.groups())
        return _build(year, month, day)

    m = _DMY_TEXT.fullmatch(text)
    if m:
        day, name, year = m.groups()
        month = _MONTHS.get(name)
        if month is None:
            return "INVALID"
        return _build(int(year), month, int(day))

    m = _MDY_TEXT.fullmatch(text)
    if m:
        name, day, year = m.groups()
        month = _MONTHS.get(name)
        if month is None:
            return "INVALID"
        return _build(int(year), month, int(day))

    return "INVALID"
